name: Washington County, RI
findings: Washington County has 572 nonprofit organizations. 239 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 195 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Washington County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 13 arts and cultural organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
